fields.name: Complete Dental Check-up
fields.description: A complete oral examination with advice on keeping your teeth and gums healthy.
benefits: Assessment of teeth and gum health
Early identification of potential dental problems
Guidance on maintaining a healthy smile

treatment_steps.title: Dental examination
treatment_steps.description: Your dentist examines your teeth, gums, and overall oral health.

treatment_steps.title: Discussion and advice
treatment_steps.description: Discuss your concerns and receive recommendations tailored to your oral health needs.

treatment_steps.title: Next steps
treatment_steps.description: Your dentist explains whether preventive care or further assessment may be helpful.

aftercare: Brush twice daily using fluoride toothpaste.
Clean between your teeth every day.
Follow your dentist's recommended check-up schedule.

fields.name: Teeth Cleaning
fields.description: Professional scaling and polishing to remove plaque, tartar, and surface stains.
benefits: Removal of plaque and tartar deposits

treatment_steps.title: Oral health assessment
treatment_steps.description: Your dentist or hygienist assesses your teeth and gum health.

treatment_steps.title: Professional cleaning
treatment_steps.description: Suitable professional instruments are used to remove plaque and tartar deposits.

treatment_steps.title: Finishing advice
treatment_steps.description: Receive guidance on brushing, cleaning between your teeth, and maintaining your oral health.

aftercare: Clean between your teeth every day.
Follow your dentist's advice if your gums feel sensitive after cleaning.

fields.name: Dr. Alex Morgan
fields.bio: Dr. Morgan focuses on preventive care and gentle treatment for patients of all ages.

fields.message: I was nervous about my root canal, but the team made me feel completely at ease. No pain at all.
Clean clinic, friendly staff, and my whitening results were better than I expected.
Booking was easy and the doctor explained every step of my treatment clearly.
My kids actually look forward to their dental check-ups now. Highly recommended.
